claim.quote: In this paper, we employ measurements from two DMTPC detectors, with operating pressures of 30-60 torr, to develop and validate a model of the directional response and performance of such detectors as a function of recoil energy.

name: Measurement of the directional sensitivity of DMTPC detectors

summary.plain: From measurements with two DMTPC detectors, the team built and validated a model of how well a gas chamber measures recoil directions, then used it to set the specifications of a 10-20 kg directional detector.
summary.technical: Measurements at 30-60 torr CF4 with optical and charge readout; the model implies a 10-20 kg scale direction-sensitive detector could provide 3-sigma confirmation that a candidate signal from a non-directional experiment was induced by dark matter.

title: Measurement of the directional sensitivity of DMTPC detectors
why_it_matters: The abstract frames the result as the specifications needed for a scalable directional detector.
